question: Should ClawHub preserve lowercase/legacy skill file aliases while rejecting case-insensitive duplicate paths, and should PROTOCOL.md be included in that package rule?
rationale: Current docs and code intentionally accept lowercase and legacy skill readme aliases, while PROTOCOL.md is not defined in the package contract; changing this affects compatibility and support expectations.

options.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
options.body: Keep SKILL.md/skill.md/skills.md compatibility but reject case-insensitive duplicate paths across publish and import surfaces, with docs/spec coverage for any PROTOCOL.md rule.

options.title: Require uppercase only
options.body: Make SKILL.md the only accepted readme casing, accepting a larger breaking change and migration burden for existing packages.

options.title: Limit to content cleanup
options.body: Leave ClawHub validation unchanged and handle the known colliding content in the separate skills repository.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
recommendation.body: Keep SKILL.md/skill.md/skills.md compatibility but reject case-insensitive duplicate paths across publish and import surfaces, with docs/spec coverage for any PROTOCOL.md rule.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the current release-boundary docs and validation behavior that define the compatibility contract being changed.
